case: Original Live-DIC UHD tensile frames 040, 100, 199; three-method progressive qualification

sourceManifest.description: Original native-UHD virtual tensile-test PNGs, copied byte for byte; no tiling, resizing, or codec decoding.
sourceManifest.coordinate_convention: Zero-based pixel centres at integer coordinates; generator stretch centre is (1920, 1080).
sourceManifest.rendering: OpenCV INTER_LINEAR inverse remapping of the archived speckle image with BORDER_REFLECT_101; uint8 PNGs saved before encoding. No additional sensor noise in this dataset.

browser: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/156.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
timingBoundary: Three full calls per method/frame with images and device already loaded. Includes per-call descriptor preparation, GPU matching, synchronization and output readback. CPM also runs oracle diagnostics, which are not included in its matchingMs field.

oracleDiagnostics.definition: At each measured work-grid center and pyramid level, compare the HOG cosine cost of the best PatchMatch state with the analytically transformed integer displacement.
